title: Federal learning calculation engine arrangement method and device based on cloud native technology

pse.problem: The computational requirements problem faced by federal learning, which includes high parallelism, dense data calculation, repeated lightweight operations, and large batch data during training.
pse.solution_function: A method for orchestrating a federated learning computing engine based on a cloud native technology. The method acquires a management unit scheduling requirement from a calculation engine controller of a federal learning platform, checks the current resource scheduling policy, binds the management unit and a calculation engine according to the scheduling requirement and current strategy, and returns binding information to the federal learning platform.
pse.solution_structure: The solution involves a cloud native platform with an API server and a resource scheduler.
pse.solution_implementation: The API server acquires a management unit scheduling requirement from the calculation engine controller of the federal learning platform, requests the resource scheduler based on this requirement, and the resource scheduler binds the management unit and the calculation engine according to the scheduling requirement.
pse.effect: This solution provides a flexible way to allocate computing resources for federal learning, potentially reducing costs and improving performance.
